change_log: v1.4: ASN delivery moved from per-message to an 8-hourly batch; PO number now read from header RFF only. No pallet-level (PAC) or serial number (GIN) segments in this map.
segments_mapped: BGM (ASN number), DTM (ship_date), RFF (po_number), NAD (supplier, ship-to), CPS/PCI (carton level), LIN (sku), QTY (qty_shipped), LOT (batch, expiry). Not mapped: PAC (pallet packing), GIN (serial numbers). Deepest packing level carried: carton.

change_log: v1.3: per-message ASN delivery; PO number read at header and line level. Superseded by v1.4.
segments_mapped: BGM, DTM, RFF (header and line), NAD, CPS/PCI, LIN, QTY, LOT. Not mapped: PAC, GIN.

change_log: v1.1: ACK_STATUS code list changed to AC, AP, RJ for the new ERP; old supplier codes (for example 1, 4, 29) are no longer translated
segments_mapped: BGM (ack number), RFF (po_number), LIN (po_line), QTY (confirmed_qty), DTM (confirmed_date), ACK_STATUS (AC, AP, RJ only)
